analysis_summary.peak_selection_conclusion: Use 540-680 nm for DA divalent peak response-time extraction; 50% devices otherwise select the PBI-Cl monovalent peak near 756-761 nm.
analysis_summary.main_conclusion: The second 50% unclipped device shows the best combination of divalent-peak contrast and bleaching speed. The 50% clipped device has similar coloring speed but lower divalent contrast. The 70% clipped device is not affected by the monovalent peak in this dataset.
